population.landmark: Existing RNA collection month-end; baseline assessments in previous three calendar months. Original RNA-selected population is retained for matched comparison, although RNA is not a predictor. Monthly precision cannot establish order within a month.
population.outcome: Existing education-adjusted continuous MoCA, exact locked source-row binding. No MCI/dementia label.
population.prior_use: Prior discovery, earlier models and temporal evaluation remain acknowledged; nested CV does not undo exposure.

preprocessing.numeric: Training median imputation, all-missing training column ->0. Training mean and population-SD scaling of imputed values; SD<=1e-12 ->1. Fixed missing indicator for every numeric column, unscaled.
preprocessing.categorical: Fixed complete one-hot dictionaries, no dropped level; blank/invalid raw values become unknown during binding. No outcome-derived vocabulary.
preprocessing.intercept: Unpenalized; all design columns centred within solver training rows.

missingness: Identical participant rows for every mask and arm. Source-invalid optional values become missing. Median and scaling learned within each inner-training fold and outer refit; numeric missingness indicators attached. All-missing training column is zero/inactive with missingness indicator. No complete-case mask-specific cohorts.

model.objective: mean squared training error + lambda*sum(coefficients squared); intercept unpenalized
model.penalty_tie: Minimum pooled inner MSE; within absolute 1e-12 MoCA-points-squared choose largest lambda.
model.prediction: Unclipped for primary and tuning; no interaction or nonlinear expansion
model.cached_preprocessing: Fit all fixed numeric columns independently using inner training rows only, then slice requested numeric/missing columns and triggered form columns. Cache scoped to horizon and outer fold. No cross-fold or global training states.

splits.source: Existing known-identity grouped master allocation from model_readiness_2026-10-24. Unchanged subsets across horizons.
splits.selection_outcomes: Only inner-validation outcomes from outer-training people may influence masks, penalties, seed pooling or final model. Outer-test outcomes inaccessible to search API.

design: Exploratory retrospective paired search on previously exposed participants; no untouched/general-optimum claim.

selection.fitness: Pooled inner MSE / pooled training-outcome variance, equivalent to maximum pooled inner R2; all candidate preprocessing within inner training folds.
selection.objective2: Count distinct acquisition groups, INCLUDING selected core information and mandatory MoCA. Proxy only, not validated time/cost.
selection.final_choice: Smallest pooled inner MSE; within1e-12 choose fewest total substantive predictors, then fewest acquisition groups, then numeric genome mask. No one-SE allowance.
selection.paired_arm: Identical budget, selection rules, rows and folds. moca27 fixes MoCA and reindexes the other27bits; mandatory MoCA counts as1predictor and1acquisition group.
selection.category_rule: motor_state is a single feature bit controlling all5dummy columns; missing indicators and form dummies follow selected parent tests. No interaction products.
selection.zero_mask: unrestricted28 includes intercept-only anchor as an explicit benchmark; moca27 zero mask is MoCA-only.

search.initial: zero, full, all singletons, full minus each optional bit, clinical-core, compact4 and MoCA-plus18 masks; fill uniform random masks.
search.parent_tournament: Pareto rank, then greater crowding, then seeded random tie
search.survival: rank, descending crowding, numeric mask; deterministic stable tie
search.cross_restart_archive: union of visited masks; repeat mask under the same context shares fitness but each restart retains its own visitation history
search.random_control: Same mandatory initial masks; uniform without replacement until exactly the number of distinct GA masks, independently per arm/horizon/fold.
search.meaning_of_thorough: Heavy bounded exploration, not an exhaustive optimum certificate. All28/27dimensions are searchable.
search.seeds: Main20261031..20261050; confirmation20361031..20361035. Same arm/horizon/fold offsets; random20271031.
search.convergence: Two consecutive200-transition plateaus, >=400generations and >=50000distinct masks. Final cross-restart and random-challenge gate before outer refits.
search.archive: Incremental exact objective envelopes and tie candidates; full fitness/visitation records in compressed SQLite. No whole-history RAM cache.

metrics.primary: 36-month pooled outer deltaR2: unrestricted28_GA minus moca27_GA
metrics.secondary: 12/24months; all45pairwise contrasts among4new search outputs plus frozen compact4,MoCA_plus18,core_plus18,prior_MoCA_GA,persistence,typical_change at each horizon. Report all in fixed order.
metrics.interval: 5000paired identity-component percentile bootstrap, seed20261031+horizon, same draws across contrasts; no refitting. Undefined R2 draws recorded, require>=4750valid. Conditional, unadjusted exploratory intervals.
metrics.final_subset_warning: One selected mask per outer fold; no global fixed panel can inherit nested OOF performance. Any subsequent all-source model needs a separate plan.
metrics.reference_predictions: Exact existing OOF predictions, never refitted. Same IDs/components/outcomes/folds required.
metrics.clipping: Unclipped tuning and main evaluation;[0,30]clipped MAE descriptive only.

budget.bound_note: Upper bound before cross-restart/shared-cache reuse, not a planned exact fit count. Random control consumes no more distinct masks than GA. No enumeration.

execution.production_requires: Subsequent explicit execution authorization bound to this v4 PLAN_LOCK and LAUNCHER_LOCK; fresh sibling output, no parent checkpoint reuse.
execution.memory_guard: Pause all contexts below4GiB MemAvailable; no partial-study scoring.
execution.startup_gate: 20CPUs,24GiB available RAM,1250GiB free disk;16CPU+1GPU;18CPU if CUDA unavailable at startup.
execution.guard_meaning: 30 days cumulative active coordinator time INCLUDING the prior v3 segment; v4 initialization carries25250.402346900984 seconds. Not evidence of convergence.
execution.fit_cancel: Numerical/integrity failures abort; only CUDA hardware failures trigger CPU fallback.
execution.cache: Fresh context-scoped caches in a new output. Never modify or rebind parent checkpoints; no participant cache import is authorized by this amendment.
execution.convergence_hold: If any convergence criterion fails, preserve inner-only diagnostics, withhold outer refits and all study metrics. Further search requires a prospective amendment without outer-outcome review.
execution.monitoring_note: No external watcher or automation is requested. The launcher retains its internal checkpoint heartbeat.

convergence.evaluation: All criteria jointly required. Main and confirmation archives must each match the combined archive at every attainable burden within1e-4 normalizedMSE; >=3of5 confirmations within1e-4 of combined best. Random may not exceed GA R2 by>1e-4.
convergence.failure: CONVERGENCE_HOLD, no outer refit or new participant predictions; never label a hard cap as convergence.
convergence.guarantee: Evidence of empirical stabilization, not global optimality.
